title: 'generated' of an 'any-of' is refused at the call: the running variant chooses its value.
why: behavioural spec 'generated' (ADR 0085): an 'any-of' contributes a dimension whose point is the value the mock serves, and a generator would serve its own instead, so no variant of the dimension would be served as selected.

interaction.description: a generator on a value a variant chooses
